fusions.name: Circle the Calves
fusions.desc: Shoulders outward from the middle of your allies, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each 2.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Bellwether Toll
fusions.desc: Rings an iron bell against an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 28 damage; when it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Stand Before the Herd
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A grazen bull fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Chewing It Over
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
